correctness.rationale: PASS. Exact full eight-history law leads to r2=s p2, r3=s p3 and h2=z2/s, h3=z3/s; the one-step hidden occupancy recursion yields T=c/s+(s-c) and h3=c/s+(s-c)h2. Consequently delta=(T-h3)/(1-h2)=s-c, b=T-delta=c/s, s=delta/(1-b), c=bs, pi=(s h2-c)/delta, and p1=m1/pi, p2=r2/s, p3=r3/s. Interior c != s gives 1-h2=delta(1-pi)/s !=0 and 1-b=delta/s !=0, proving global uniqueness, not merely generic rank. For two seasons pi can vary while p1 and c are adjusted to preserve m1,m2,d12. When c=s hidden states after first season are iid and only products pi p1, c p_t are observed, so arbitrary length is insufficient. Independently summed all 8 observed histories from all 8 latent histories with exact fractions and inverted a nonstationary, drifting-detection example; finite test supplements the analytic proof.
